channel.title: Applied Linguistics — Calls for Papers & Conferences
channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 4th International Conference on Research Measurement in Applied Linguistics: Advances and Challenges
item.description: Measurement is a fundamental component of rigorous inquiry in Applied Linguistics. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 18th International Conference on Corpus Linguistics
item.description: The eighteenth edition of AELINCO's International Conference on Corpus Linguistics (CILC2027) will be held at the University of Ferrara, May 19-21, following the AELINCO three days schedule. The conference is organised locally by the University Language Center (CLA-UNIFE) and the Department of Humanities. The University of Ferrara is one of the oldest universities in the world. The foundation of the ‘Studio di Ferrara’ was granted by Pope Boniface IX with the papal bull ‘In Supremae Dignitatis’

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro - "Issues 1 and 2 2027" (Jrnl)
item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 7th International Conference of the American Pragmatics Association
item.description: We are pleased to announce the program for the 7th International Conference of the American Pragmatics Association (AMPRA), to be held 5-7 November 2026 online, with East Texas A&M as virtual host. The goal of this conference is to promote both theoretical and applied research in pragmatics, and to bring together scholars who are interested in different subfields of pragmatics (philosophical, linguistic, cognitive, social, intercultural, interlanguage, etc.). item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 15th International Conference of English as a Lingua Franca
item.description: We are happy to announce that ELF15, the 15th International Conference of English as a Lingua Franca, will take place at TU Dortmund University in Germany, from 23 to 25 September 2027. The theme of the conference will be: “ELF 15: Whose English? Whose Norms? Whose Futures?” The call for papers will be sent out later in October 2026, and submission of abstracts will close on 15 January 2027. Please check the ELF 15 conference website for updates: https://anglistik.kuwi.tu-dortmund.de/elf

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 8th Annual Sociolinguistics Symposium
item.description: The 8th Annual Sociolinguistics Symposium (SoSy) at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign is an annual research event organized by graduate students in Linguistics, providing a forum for scholarly exchange across sociolinguistics and related fields. This year’s theme, The Social Life of Language: Capturing Creative Chaos, highlights the creative and often unpredictable nature of language in social life. item.description: Logos et Littera – Journal of Interdisciplinary Approaches to Text invites submissions for its upcoming non-thematic issue. We welcome innovative original research articles and review articles in linguistics, translation studies, LSP, terminology and literature. We encourage contributions that offer innovative insights, employ diverse methodologies, and engage with theoretical and practical dimensions.
